propositions: Coverage instrumentation is collected independently on all three Ubuntu Python cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) despite identical source and no version-specific branches, duplicating measurement effort.
Measured instrumentation overhead is 34 wall-seconds per uninstrumented cell (median A=511.16s with coverage, median B=477.16s without), confirming tracing cost without critical-path benefit.

Coverage collection should be retained only on Ubuntu Python 3.13 (the primary/newest stable cell) while 3.11 and 3.12 remain as uninstrumented behavioral-compatibility cells, matching Django/NumPy/SciPy precedent.

All four matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13, macOS 3.13) must retain both default and integration pytest tiers; only Ubuntu 3.13 receives coverage flags, others receive empty string to avoid GitHub Actions falsy-empty trap.
Workflow contract test must verify exact cell expansion, tier retention, and coverage-flag distribution; defect seeds must fail when all-Ubuntu coverage or zero-coverage conditions are restored.
